trigger: On the fixed 60-base clean frame, two independent blind author rounds produced 37 unique context proposals. A-only/B-context manipulation checks and one profile-balance supplement yielded 24 one-per-base, 12/12-profile proposals, but only three honest speaker/addressee and three honest direction/ownership atoms. Reclassifying identity or scope atoms merely to meet six-per-family would misstate the intervention.
interpretation_effect: Primary inference remains about the aggregate finite 24-item context-required set. Family-stratified results are descriptive only and especially underpowered for the two three-item families.
